translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nabz ne Devet kx yrbzle mz kxrmailz ngr dzbe kxnzngrng.

content.text: Yawe, nim King x Gct rnge. Rlxtibo bam kx naxlrme natqnge,
X na-aoti kz drtwrm, mz nzatutr-krm nzkrka'-krnge.
Kxetu, mz nourla kang kqlu natqnge sa navzbz bam.
X nakrka'-zvzbo bam, mz nzaenzli-krbo natqm kxmrlz.
Yawe, trnginipqu Gct kx abrtzlvzle da kxtrka.
X trmnc-lxblrwamuu mz kxdrka'-ngrng.
Leplz kx nzglqpx-lzbqng trtxpnzngr nzmnctr-krbzlr bam,
Murde rblxbz mz leplz kx mrlz-zvzbz badr nzale-krdr alwx nztutr-krbzlr mz mzpq.
Odatiq kxnzpokiang,
X obqszo-zvzq kxnzrnibqng x kxnzesabrting.
A' mz nzaodu-zvz-krm, delc navztr-ngrne Mangr-nzangiongr nim,
X nayrngzobo mz nzamatqngr nim.
Yawe, mailz ninge mz nqmq krm kxtubq, murde enqmi rnge nzkqlu-zlwzng.
X aelwa-zpwx-ngrm bange me pnz drtwrm.
Da angidr trvzpxpuu mz nao enqmi rngeng.
Murde mz nabzdr la nzodatingr txpwz.
X mz nzycmne-krdr nzmailzlr leplz
Mz nzbatr-krbzlr nzbz-krdr esz'-krdr.
Gct, plzpx alwx ngrdr x ayrplapx nidr,
Mz nzprtz-mou-krdr mz trtxki scdr.
Mapulrpxngr nidr mz nzkqlukr alwx ngrdrng,
Murde nzpxtxpx-zvz-ngrdr nim.
A' leplz amrlx kcng tzabrtrpzlr drtwrdr bam na-abrtzng.
X nangr-along mz nzelalz-krm drtwrdr.
Aclve-angidr kxnzmrlztilr nim
Murde nabilvzlr nim.
Yawe, amrlz-zvzq kxnztubqng. X nivz lrm o-ngalelvzle nidr
Mz nzapu-krde temz ngr lomrdr kc tqyrputrngr nipna.
